blocks.text: PHOENIX— Devin Booker had 30 points, seven assists and three steals, and the Phoenix Suns beat the Charlotte Hornets 101-96 in the NBA on Thursday night. Miles Bridges got the win in his first meeting against his former team as the Suns won for the fourth time in five games after a 1-5 start. Dillon Brooks added 15 points and Collin Gillespie had 13 for the Suns. READ: NBA: Suns ground Rockets for 1st back-to-back wins of season Bridges finished with 11 points and six rebounds.
